summary.purpose: Extracts monoline policy transactions, premium breakdowns, agent details, and job status for commercial lines underwriting (Agribusiness) within specified policy period and job close date ranges.
summary.high_level_narrative: The script declares date parameters for policy period start/end and change start date. It then executes a UNION ALL of two major SELECT statements. The first SELECT retrieves detailed line-level transactions for Commercial Package product lines (Commercial Property, General Liability, Commercial Auto, Crime, Inland Marine, Workers Comp) by joining policy period, policy, policy term, policy line, job, account, producer code, organization, and numerous lookup tables. It calculates written premium per line using correlated subqueries against line-specific transaction tables (pcx_cp7transaction, pcx_gl7transaction_gle, pcx_ca7transaction, pcx_cr7transaction, pc_imtransaction, pcx_wc7transaction). The second SELECT retrieves the Commercial Package Policy (C.P.P.) as a whole with a static LineOfBusiness 'C.P.P.' and uses the policy period's TransactionCostRPT as written premium. Both SELECTs map UW company codes to abbreviations (LRM, WRM, SON, UNK), derive agent code/name, farm underwriting territory, producer code, job details, and policy period status. The outer query then pivots transaction-level data into separate columns based on transaction type (Renewal, Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange) using CASE expressions, outputting premium amounts and effective dates per transaction type. Filtering ensures only bound or audit-complete policy periods with job close dates before the policy end date are included.
outputs: Monoline Policy Transaction Extract (result set with columns: ProfitCenter, ProductCode, LineOfBusiness, PolicyNumber, OriginalEffectiveDate, PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, AccountNumber, Company, PrimaryInsuredName, AgentCode, AgentName, FarmUWTerritory, MostRecentTran, SubWritten_Premium, SubWritten_Date, CancelledDate, CancelledEffDate, CancelledPremium, ReinstatedPremium, ReinstatedDate, ReinstatedEffDate, ChangePremium, ChangeDate)

Pivoting transaction types (Renewal, Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange) into separate premium and date columns using CASE expressions
Filtering on policy period status (Bound, AuditComplete) and job close date before @POLENDDATE

Lookup tables for job types, policy period status, bind options, UW company codes, job descriptions, policy period source types, profit center types, farm UW territories

knowledge_profile.purpose: Extracts monoline policy transactions, premium breakdowns, agent details, and job status within policy period and job close date ranges for PolicyCenter Commercial Lines Underwriting (Agribusiness). The query produces a transaction-level extract with derived columns for written premium, cancellation, reinstatement, and policy change premiums based on transaction type.
key_logic: Declare and set date parameters: @POLSTARTDATE (8/1/2025), @POLENDDATE (7/31/2026), @CHANGESTARTDATE (7/1/2026), @curmthyr (previous month/year concatenated)

First SELECT branch: Handles CommercialPackage product with line-specific premium calculation via correlated subqueries to line transaction tables (pcx_cp7transaction, pcx_gl7transaction_gle, etc.) based on PatternCode
Second SELECT branch (UNION ALL): Handles 'C.P.P.' line of business using direct pp.TransactionCostRPT as Written_Premium
Both branches join core policy tables (pc_policyperiod, pc_policy, pc_job) and reference tables for codes/descriptions
Derive LineOfBusiness from pp.PatternCode with CASE mapping to descriptive names
Derive Company from uwc.name with CASE mapping to LRM/WRM/SON/UNK
Derive AgentCode from org.Code_Ext (RTRIM, CAST to char(6))
Derive ProducerCode from prod.code (RIGHT 3 chars of RTRIM, default '999')

Outer SELECT applies CASE expressions on TranType (jt.TYPECODE) to populate transaction-type-specific columns: MostRecentTran, SubWritten_Premium/Date, CancelledDate/EffDate/Premium, ReinstatedPremium/Date/EffDate, ChangePremium/Date
Filter on job CloseDate < @POLENDDATE and policy period status IN ('Bound', 'AuditComplete') in first branch; second branch filters on j.CloseDate IS NOT NULL and pol.IssueDate IS NOT NULL

transformations.description: Map PatternCode to descriptive LineOfBusiness
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cp7line' THEN 'Commercial Property Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'GeneralLiabilityLine_GLE' THEN 'General Liability Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'ca7line' THEN 'Commercial Auto Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cr7line' THEN 'Crime Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'imline' THEN 'Inland Marine Line' WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'WC7Line' THEN 'Workers Comp Line' ELSE pp.PatternCode END

transformations.description: Map UW company name to abbreviated Company code
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN uwc.name = 'Lightning Rod Mutual' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uwc.name = 'Western Reserve Mutual' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uwc.name = 'Sonnenberg Mutual' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

transformations.description: Derive AgentCode from organization Code_Ext (right-trim and cast to char(6))
transformations.expression: CAST(RTRIM(org.Code_Ext) AS CHAR(6))

transformations.description: Derive ProducerCode from producer code (right 3 chars of trimmed code, default '999')
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN prod.code IS NULL THEN '999' ELSE RIGHT(RTRIM(prod.code), 3) END

transformations.description: Calculate Written_Premium for CommercialPackage product via correlated subqueries per PatternCode
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN pp.ProductCode = 'CommercialPackage' THEN CASE WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cp7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_cp7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'GeneralLiabilityLine_GLE' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_gl7transaction_gle tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'ca7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_ca7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'cr7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_cr7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'imline' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pc_imtransaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN pp.PatternCode = 'WC7Line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_wc7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) END ELSE pp.TransactionCostRPT END
